title: Annual reports.
bodyText: The authority shall submit a report to the legislature no later than twenty days prior to the convening of each regular session that details the progress of the condominium loan program, aggregate data on the loans issued under this part, and the balance of the condominium loan revolving fund.
bodyHtml: [§514D-7]  Annual reports.  The authority shall submit a report to the legislature no later than twenty days prior to the convening of each regular session that details the progress of the condominium loan program, aggregate data on the loans issued under this part, and the balance of the condominium loan revolving fund. [L 2025, c 296, pt of §19]
